top_signals.title: The Paradox of Victory: When Winning in Ukraine Raises the Nuclear Stakes
top_signals.summary:
In 2022, Jeremy Shapiro warned in “We Are on a Path to Nuclear War” that the war between Russia and Ukraine was heading toward nuclear escalation.
